channel.title: Gotham Gazette Wire
channel.description: Latest news on Gotham City, Bruce Wayne, Wayne Manor, and Wayne Enterprises

item.title: Wayne Enterprises Unveils New Clean Energy Reactor for Gotham Harbor
item.description: Wayne Enterprises announced a new fusion-based energy project aimed at powering the Gotham Harbor district, promising to cut the city's dependence on aging coal plants.

item.title: Bruce Wayne Hosts Annual Charity Gala at Wayne Manor
item.description: Gotham's most eligible billionaire once again opened the doors of Wayne Manor for the annual Wayne Foundation gala, raising funds for the Gotham Children's Hospital.

item.title: GCPD Reports Drop in Crime Rate Near Downtown Gotham
item.description: Commissioner's office releases quarterly statistics showing a modest decline in violent crime across Gotham's downtown precincts, crediting increased patrols and community programs.

item.title: Wayne Manor Grounds to Undergo Historic Restoration
item.description: The Wayne family estate will begin a multi-month restoration of its east wing and gardens, preserving the manor's 19th-century architecture for future generations.

item.title: Wayne Enterprises Stock Rises After Strong Quarterly Earnings
item.description: Shares of Wayne Enterprises climbed after the conglomerate posted better-than-expected earnings, driven by growth in its applied sciences and biotech divisions.

item.title: Gotham City Council Debates New Infrastructure Bill
item.description: City council members clashed over a proposed bill to fund repairs to Gotham's aging bridges and subway tunnels, with several council members citing Wayne Enterprises as a potential private partner.

item.title: Bruce Wayne Spotted at Gotham University Engineering Symposium
item.description: Bruce Wayne made a rare public appearance at Gotham University, where he announced a new scholarship fund for students pursuing engineering and applied sciences.
